scripts.build: pnpm run build:core:libs && pnpm run build:parsers && pnpm run build:core:index && pnpm run build:ui
scripts.build:core:libs: (cd packages/common && pnpm exec tsup) && (cd packages/tokens && pnpm exec tsup) && (cd packages/core && pnpm exec tsup)
scripts.build:core:index: cd packages/core && pnpm exec tsup --config tsup.index.config.ts
scripts.build:parsers: (cd packages/onnx && pnpm exec tsup) && (cd packages/tflite && pnpm exec tsup) && (cd packages/keras && pnpm exec tsup) && (cd packages/executorch && pnpm exec tsup) && (cd packages/torchscript && pnpm exec tsup) && (cd packages/savedmodel && pnpm exec tsup) && (cd packages/gguf && pnpm exec tsup)
scripts.build:ui: (cd packages/react && pnpm exec vite build) && pnpm run check:svelte
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:ts && pnpm run check:svelte
scripts.typecheck:ts: pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p packages/common/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p packages/onnx/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p packages/tflite/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p packages/keras/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p packages/executorch/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p packages/torchscript/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p packages/savedmodel/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p packages/gguf/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p packages/tokens/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p packages/react/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p packages/svelte/tsconfig.json
